dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: The skill compiles extensive AWS documentation into a decision tree, but most of the content (latency windows, bucket‑policy statements, KMS permissions, CLI commands) is already known to a capable model. It adds limited novel insight beyond restating known facts.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific troubleshooting flow: capture signal → map to category → check get‑trail‑status before event selectors → verify bucket policy, KMS, org‑trail shadow status, then remediate. The order (status → selectors → bucket/KMS) reflects real CloudTrail diagnostics. Only minor generic advice ("ask user for info") prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a comprehensive NEVER list with specific reasoning for each pitfall (e.g., never assume outage, never confuse describe‑trails with get‑trail‑status, never enable all S3 data events without cost warning, never delete a trail as first fix). Each anti‑pattern is justified with real‑world consequences.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter includes all required fields (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, metadata). The description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides activation_triggers and an invocation_schema. Output format is precisely defined.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (activation → mindset → quick reference → detailed steps), but the document is long and some critical rules (e.g., bucket‑policy ACL condition) are buried deep, causing potential cognitive overload for quick triage.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (start‑logging, bucket‑policy changes) are tightly constrained with explicit commands and verification steps, while analytical steps remain flexible. Minor omission: no explicit guard against running start‑logging on an already‑active trail.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: The skill follows a recognizable structure (Activation → Mindset → Quick reference → Process → Output), but the layout mixes custom sections (e.g., Quick navigation) with the standard pattern, making it slightly ad‑hoc.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI snippets, decision tree, and output example, enabling an agent to execute the skill. Some commands are outdated (e.g., get‑insight‑selectors vs newer list‑insights‑selectors) and cross‑account bucket‑policy edge cases are not fully covered, which could cause execution gaps.
